sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which part of your body is most important for tracking the ball when catching?
In the game of Kabaddi, a player entering the opponent's side is called a:
Tadasana is also known as the:
What is the correct way to receive a hard pass in football?
options: B) Absorb the impact softly with the side of the foot
C) Stop it with your hands
D) Turn your back to it
questions.answer: B) Absorb the impact softly with the side of the foot

questions.question_text: Which movement is a locomotor skill (moving from one place to another)?
Why is warming up important before playing a sport?
options: B) To cool down the body

questions.question_text: In the traditional game of Pitthou (Lagori), what is used as the target?
options: B) A pile of flat stones
questions.answer: B) A pile of flat stones

questions.question_text: Deep breathing in Yoga helps to:
options: B) Calm your mind and improve focus
questions.answer: B) Calm your mind and improve focus

questions.question_text: What is the best display of sportsmanship after losing a game?
options: C) Shaking hands with the winning team
D) Leaving the field without speaking
questions.answer: C) Shaking hands with the winning team

questions.question_text: When holding a cricket bat, where should your hands be placed on the handle?
options: A) Far apart at the top and bottom
B) Close together in the middle
C) Only one hand at the very bottom
D) Both hands on the blade
questions.answer: B) Close together in the middle

questions.question_text: List two safety rules you must follow while practicing throwing and catching with a partner.
questions.answer: 1. Always ensure your partner is looking at you before you throw the ball. 2. Do not throw the ball too hard if you are standing very close to each other.

questions.question_text: What is the difference between hopping and jumping?
questions.answer: Hopping means taking off and landing on the same single foot. Jumping means taking off and landing on both feet together.

questions.question_text: Name two things you should check in your sports equipment (like a bat or ball) before starting a game.
questions.answer: You should check if the ball is properly inflated (has enough air) and if the handle grip on the bat is secure and not torn.

questions.question_text: Describe the posture for Vrikshasana (Tree Pose).
questions.answer: Stand straight on one leg, bend the other knee and place the sole of that foot on the inner thigh of the standing leg, and join your hands together above your head.

questions.question_text: Why is it important to stay hydrated (drink water) during Physical Education classes?
questions.answer: It is important because when we play, we sweat and lose water. Drinking water keeps our body cool and prevents us from feeling dizzy or exhausted.

sections.section_name: Section C - Sports Mechanics & Fill in the Blanks

questions.question_text: Fill in the blanks regarding locomotor movements: 1. Moving forward with a long step followed by a short step is called ____. 2. A fast walk where one foot is always in contact with the ground is a ____. 3. Springing from one foot and landing on the other foot is a ____.
questions.answer: 1. Galloping, 2. Power walk (or brisk walk), 3. Leap

questions.question_text: Match the traditional games to their required equipment: 1. Gilli-Danda  2. Kho-Kho  3. Pitthou (Lagori). (Options: 7 flat stones and a ball, Two wooden sticks, No equipment needed/Just open ground)
questions.answer: 1. Gilli-Danda - Two wooden sticks, 2. Kho-Kho - No equipment needed/Just open ground, 3. Pitthou (Lagori) - 7 flat stones and a ball

questions.question_text: During a game of football, your teammate accidentally kicks you in the shin, and it hurts. You are very angry and want to push him. What is the correct sportsmanship behavior to handle this situation?
questions.answer: Step 1: Take a deep breath to control my anger instead of pushing. Step 2: Understand that it was an accident during play. Step 3: Tell my teammate, 'Ouch, that hurt, but I know you didn't mean it.' Step 4: Step off the field for a minute, inform the teacher, and apply ice if needed before returning to play.

questions.question_text: Plan a simple 3-step warm-up routine for your class before they play a game of cricket (which involves running, throwing, and batting).
questions.answer: Step 1 (Cardio): Start with 2 minutes of light jogging around the boundary to get the heart rate up. Step 2 (Upper Body): Do arm circles (10 forward, 10 backward) to loosen the shoulder joints for throwing and batting. Step 3 (Lower Body): Perform 10 lunges on each leg to stretch the muscles used for running fast between the wickets.
